Edit the image to make the clothing modest with minimal changes.

Do not keep bikinis, underwear, lingerie, erotic clothing, or explicit nudity in the final image.

Only add the minimum necessary coverage to hide nipples, breasts, genitals, buttocks, anus, and overly exposed body areas. Prefer small edits to the existing outfit, such as extending the fabric, raising the neckline, lengthening the hem, adding simple inner layers, or adding short sleeves or modest coverage that matches the original clothing.

Do not replace the whole outfit if a small edit is enough. Do not add large coats, heavy jackets, or completely new clothing styles unless absolutely necessary.

Keep the original outfit style, color, material, and overall look as much as possible. Preserve the person’s identity, face, expression, pose, hairstyle, body shape, lighting, background, camera angle, composition, and overall image style. If the clothing is already modest enough, keep the image unchanged.
